Fills one 0x1a0 company-stat block with building total, value, HQ flag, market share, size and bonus counters.

Stores master/music/effect volume settings at +0x1d0/+0x1d4/+0x1d8 through Sound_ConvertVolumeSetting and reports whether the value changed.
Acquires the stream lock, sets state bit 2 and returns 0 when the stream is already busy, otherwise advances the +0x20 iterator and locks the destination.

Scans the +4 array for an entry whose +0x34 equals param_1 and whose +0x30 is the index of param_2 in the current player array.

Scans the global +0x3c map for a type 0x1d object whose +0x10c equals this+0x164.

Returns a random type/level-indexed value from table 0x5727fc, forcing 1 for type 6 when the player count is positive and +0x44 is zero.
Picks a random object in the player's +0x148 map via Random_Mod and returns its +0x3c value.

Sets the +0x84 rect from x/y plus size +0x1a/+0x1c and propagates renderer state through Renderer_CopyStateToChildren.

Stops the voice through vtable +0x48, destroys the child list when +0x34 is set and releases the voice through vtable +0x34.
When byte +0xfe is set, reloads the speech set and clears the flag.

Appends the object to the global registry at +0x2c3f8, or inserts it at the given index through IDMap_InsertGrow.

Scans the 0x28-stride buffer pair from Object_GetBufferPair for a record whose +2 ushort equals the key.
Projects screen x/y through Map_ComputeBlitRect and splits the cell index by map width into x and y.

Averages Game_MapInputIndex over the 8 active mask bytes and returns 0 when none are set.

Walks a line from (266,274) toward (0x10a,0x112) with Map_GetTileByte and returns another object within 15 units.

Validates the record index, ensures the list is loaded, converts its position to ints, sets four shorts and calls Sprite_BlitClipped.
Sums each players Stats_SumFilteredFloats3 total over six slots and returns the requested players rounded percentage share.

Returns the +0x148 record minimizing squared center/bottom distance to the supplied object.
